preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of cities N must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(Ai) <= 50 and 1 <= len(Bi) <= 50 for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)
preconditions.description: The length of city names Ai and Bi must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ci <= 1000 for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)
preconditions.description: The cost Ci must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of cards must be equal to N - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the cards in their proper original order followed by the total cost of the travel.

postconditions.expression: total_cost == sum(Ci for Ai, Bi, Ci in sorted_cards)
postconditions.description: The total cost must be the sum of the costs of the cards in the proper order.
